item.title: What a Seawater Sample Can Tell Scientists About Ocean Health
item.description: UNESCO is growing its environmental DNA, or eDNA, expedition programme. This ambitious and cost-effective project can give usable ocean data in a couple of weeks using a small number of seawater samples collected by citizen scientists.
